app.name: BloodLink
app.tagline: A privacy-first donor coordination tool for our club.
health.title: Service status
footer.notice: Hospitals and blood banks decide final blood safety. This tool only helps the club coordinate willing donors.
errors.404.title: Page not found
errors.404.body: The page you asked for does not exist.
errors.500.title: Something went wrong
errors.500.body: Please try again later. If the problem persists, contact a coordinator.
auth.login.title: Coordinator login
auth.login.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
auth.not_logged_in: You must log in to view that page.
donor.register.title: Register as a blood donor
donor.register.intro: Fill in your details. A coordinator will phone you to verify before you appear in any matching.
donor.register.name: Your name
donor.register.consent_contact: I consent to being contacted by the club about blood requests.
donor.register.consent_verify: I understand the club will call to verify me and that final eligibility is decided at the donation site.
donor.registered.title: Thank you
donor.registered.body: We have received your registration. A coordinator will phone you soon to verify. Until then, you are not yet listed in the matching pool.
donor.registered.notice: Save this link now. We will not show it again.
donor.registered.manage_warning: Anyone with this link can change or delete your record. Do not share it.
donor.manage.title: Manage your donor record
donor.manage.available: I am currently available to donate
donor.manage.phone_label: Update phone (leave blank to keep current)
donor.manage.phone_help: If you change your phone number, your status resets to unverified until a coordinator calls again.
donor.manage.delete_confirm: Delete your record and all contact history? This cannot be undone.
coordinator.donors.title: Donors
coordinator.donors.col.name: Name
coordinator.donors.note_warning: Do not enter medical information here.
coordinator.donors.reveal_warning: This reveal action is recorded in the audit log.
coordinator.donors.regenerate_link_help: A new link will be shown once. The old link will stop working immediately.
request.new.title: Request blood
request.new.intro: Fill in the details below. A coordinator will phone you to verify, then we will look for matching donors.
request.new.note_warning: Do not enter medical details here.
request.new.consent_contact: I consent to being contacted by the club about this request.
request.new.ip_rate_limited: Too many requests from your network. Please wait an hour and try again.
request.new.phone_too_many: This number already has 3 active requests. Please cancel an existing one first.
request.created.title: Request received
request.created.body: We have received your request. A coordinator will phone you soon to verify. Until then, no matching will happen yet.
request.created.notice: Save this link now. We will not show it again.
request.created.warning: Anyone with this link can view the status of your request and cancel it. Do not share it.
request.tracking.title: Request status
request.tracking.not_found: We could not find a request with that link.
request.tracking.cancel_confirm: Cancel your request? This cannot be undone.
coordinator.requests.title: Blood requests
coordinator.requests.search: Search by token, hospital, requester name or phone
request.new.units_help: Whole blood units only. Platelets and plasma are out of scope.
